releaseNotes: The final-source-layout workflow (.github/workflows/final-source-layout.yml) is removed. It was one-shot automation for the directory-migration arc that closed at v0.63.0, but it still carried `contents: write` and a step that self-commits to PR branches, and it would have fired again on any PR touching scripts/repair-migrated-fixtures.py or the workflow file itself. Same rationale as removing the expired pr99-publisher.yml in v0.76.0 (#120): a standing write-permission workflow whose job is done is risk with no remaining function.

The four migration scripts the workflow drove — scripts/fix-source-layout-contracts.py, scripts/refactor-source-layout.py, scripts/repair-final-source-layout.py, and scripts/repair-migrated-fixtures.py — are removed with it. A full-repo reference sweep found no caller outside the workflow: the workflow referenced one script, and nothing referenced the workflow. scripts/sync-skill-runtime.sh, the one live script in that directory, is untouched.
